text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Senior year is here at last, and as for Mejiro Ardan's progress…

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Continuing with the latest Twinkle Series news, we now return to our coverage oooon…

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: The self-same racer who made such a splash during last year's Classics, a young lady of the Mejiro family, Mejiro Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: I tell you, her showing at the Japanese Derby was one for the ages. And I'm hoping for even more astonishing feats in her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …While I am honored, this is also a touch embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan's amazing performance in the Classics has completely changed the public's perception of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: People have stopped referencing her sister's accomplishments, and they're finally recognizing Ardan for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But on the other hand…

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: All that said, we'll have to wait and see just how well she'll be able to keep up with Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Is Oguri Cap really in a league of her own?

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: I think that's a good way to put it, yes. There are plenty of other Umamusume who are just as strong or popular but…

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: So far, she's overturned expectations every time she's hit the track… Speaking as a fan, there's simply nothing more thrilling than that.

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure there's ever been another runner with the same level of sheer inspirational star power as Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Announcer B
text_block_list.text: Her running seizes the attention of her fans and opponents alike. That's the mark of a generational talent right there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …As the star of the Twinkle Series, Oguri Cap has countless lights and cameras in her orbit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I believe that to be true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The light Oguri emanates when she runs… is almost overwhelmingly powerful. Extraordinarily so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It may sound strange… but I can't help believing that her radiance promises a place in history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Whereas the light I have at this moment remains fleeting and faint compared to that of Oguri and her closest rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Which is precisely why the following occurs to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If I were to shine brightly enough to drown out their light—Oguri's included…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wonder just how many hearts in which that would leave a lasting impression.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, what I'm about to say will sound over the top, but please refrain from laughing as you listen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: In the ultimate moment of this senior year…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to create a turning point that changes this seemingly inevitable path in history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will defeat Oguri and turn the valuation of all things—as they are in this moment—on its head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Moving forward, that is to be my goal.
choice_data_list: …"The steepest, most strenuous path of all," right?
…"The steepest, most strenuous path of all," right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I would not have made it this far alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I couldn't have done it without my precious rivals or the wonderful races we've run together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Nor without you, Trainer. You had faith in me, walked beside me, and guided me towards the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Had even one of you been missing from my journey, I highly doubt I would be standing here now, in this moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am truly grateful. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Will you be there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: On this path—the steepest, most strenuous path—to reshape the history people dream of…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Will you be there… with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't even have to think about it. As Mejiro Ardan's trainer, I know exactly what I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …"Pulverize"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Heh! Hehehe! …Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I-I do apologize, Trainer! It's just that your choice of words was… rather amusing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Still… Hehe, there's something wonderful about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Strong, courageous, and refreshing… Yes, I think I'd like to use phrasing like that myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan seems to have enjoyed the way I put that, but after all that praise, I'm the one who ends up blushing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's align our sights on history itself, and—at its turning point—obliterate it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our new goal set, it's time to take on senior year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now that our objective's decided…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's pay the shrine a New Year's visit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Submitting to Mejiro Ardan's will, I head along to the shrine with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You know, I've always gone with other members of the Mejiro family to visit a shrine at New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This year, however, I very much hoped to go with you instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why indeed. I shall leave the answer to your imagination, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? There's no line at the moment. Shall we use this opportunity to go and offer our prayers?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What will you be wishing for, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my! A wish on my behalf? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I was also thinking of asking for your continued good health. Could this be a case of us… looking out for one another?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I must say, though, you needn't wish for me "to stay healthy"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I trust that as long as you're with me, I'll always be feeling my very best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, our shrine visit comes to an end. Now we're ready to take on the new year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're quite avaricious, aren't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am also planning to continue working hard so that I can scale the heights you wished for me to reach.
choice_data_list: I've got high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: By all means, hope away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, our shrine visit comes to an end. Now we're ready to take on the new year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, I'm just… a little surprised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: After all, that wish has already—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I was also thinking of wishing for your happiness, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hence, my surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we both pray for one another's happiness?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our shrine visit ends with us both wishing for the other to be happy. Now we're ready to take on the new year!
